target: AArch64 PCI QEMU graphical guest, one vCPU
verified: Five rounds of MessageScan, KeyScan, CharScan, and FlushMessages polling did not run the peer task.
An explicit Yield handed execution to the next ready peer.
A blocked MessageGet yielded, received the peer's posted command, and resumed.
TaskMessageSchedulingChecks returned 0x2a and the native compiler reset successfully.
scope_note: This verifies the current cooperative compatibility bridge on the recorded ISO. It does not make the pinned upstream Sched.ZC the active scheduler or prove live UTM/Pi scheduling behavior.
